claim: With JavaScript off the contact form can no longer send name, email and message in the URL
evidence: contact.mjs, javaScriptEnabled false at 360: Enter in #contact-name leaves location at http://127.0.0.1:4173/contact; the submit button is disabled in the static HTML (ContactForm.tsx:226 disabled={!scripted || ...}), so implicit submission has no default button to fire; the noscript notice shows.

claim: The «أنس» brand link inside the open menu closes the modal menu
evidence: nojs.mjs (JS on, 360 touch): menu open, aria-expanded true, html overflow hidden; after clicking the brand in the dialog: path '/', dialog.open false, html overflow visible (SiteHeader.tsx:147 onClick setOpen(false)).

claim: Below 1024px with JavaScript off the header shows the room links instead of a dead «القائمة»
evidence: nojs.mjs: 8 visible header links and menu button display none at 320/360/1024 on /scenes, /contact, /journal, the 404 and /policies/refund. Side effect recorded as DSN-PAGES-10 (the wrapped header stays sticky at 200px).

claim: With JavaScript off a scenes tile opens the photograph
evidence: nojs.mjs: the first tile is <a href="/images/v2/street4-street-sign-1000.webp" role="button"> (SceneGallery.tsx:104-120). Captions are still not visible without script, which the fix did not ask for.

claim: With JavaScript off the scenes and journal filters are hidden instead of dead
evidence: nojs.mjs: main [role=group] display none on /scenes at 320/360/1024 (scenes.module.css:38-42); journal.module.css:33-37 has the same rule.

claim: The scenes and journal filters announce what they left, «الكل» included
evidence: scenes.mjs: the polite status reads «الكل: 19 صورة», «أماكن: 7 صور», then «الكل: 19 صورة» again after returning; JournalList.tsx:56-58 has the same status line.

claim: The lightbox step arrows are always backed
evidence: scenes.module.css:239-240 background color-mix(aub-900 60%); visible in shots/lightbox-844x390.png. The photo-sizing defect beside them is new (DSN-PAGES-07).

claim: Policy page titles follow the published policy title
evidence: policies/[slug]/page.tsx:24-31 reads getPublishedPolicies()[id].data.title; exported titles «سياسة المتجر/الخصوصية/التوصيل/الاسترجاع · أنس عبدالله القرني» match the h1s (pages.mjs).

claim: The journal's name comes from the menu label, and a blank label falls back
evidence: content.ts:186-189 `label.trim()` then `label || 'المجلس'`; used by /journal (title, h1), the 404 doors (Lost.tsx:39), the book's next door (BookView.tsx:262) and the post crumb (PostView.tsx).

claim: The /book cover states the right sizes and loads first
evidence: BookView.tsx:58-65 sizes '(min-width: 1024px) 400px, (min-width: 560px) 40vw, 220px', loading eager, fetchPriority high; at 360 the cover wraps alone at its 220px min-inline-size (book.module.css:9-13).

claim: First-screen images on /journal and /scenes are eager
evidence: JournalList.tsx:76-77 (lead card eager, fetchPriority high), journal/page.tsx:49-55 (empty-state photo eager, high), SceneGallery.tsx:130 (first five tiles eager).

claim: «اطلب جلسة» replaces only an untouched message and a replaced message gets a new submission key
evidence: prefill.ts servicePrefill resetKey; ContactForm.tsx:57-75. contact.mjs at 1440: after clicking the fifth service the message is «أرغب في جلسة استشارية: التوريد.\n», focus is in #contact-message and the form top (92px) clears the header bottom (68px).

claim: A 422 from the function marks the refused field
evidence: ContactForm.tsx:128-134 maps fieldErrors to REJECTED messages and focuses the first; not exercised live (the function is unreachable by rule).

claim: Media lookups are chunked so a long post list cannot exceed the URL limit
evidence: content.ts:81-97 loops over MEDIA_CHUNK slices.

claim: A nested list renders inside the previous item without a stray bullet
evidence: article.mjs rebuilt the renderer's output for a nested list: the inner ul sits inside the second li with circle markers and no empty bullet (shots/article-360-crop-lists.png).

claim: Menu and scenes wipes have explicit to-keyframes
evidence: site.module.css:191-198 menu-weave from/to; scenes.module.css:69-76, 161-168, 214-229 tile-in, viewer-in, photo-next, photo-prev each have `to { clip-path: inset(0 0 0 0) }`.

claim: State cues survive forced colours
evidence: site.module.css:184-190 (.here/.menuHere CanvasText), journal.module.css:25-31 and scenes.module.css:25-31 (pressed filter Highlight).

claim: Rings on toned controls are drawn inside, and the tile ring over photos is two-tone
evidence: globals.css:207-209; scenes.module.css:91-103. Screenshots: the lightbox «إغلاق» shows its inner ring (shots/scenes-1440-lightbox.png); a focused tile shows the saffron ring in an aub-900 frame (shots/scenes-360-tilefocus.png).

claim: The /journal/_ placeholder renders inside the public layout with lang and dir
evidence: pages.mjs: /journal/_ lang ar, dir rtl, title «هذا الطريق لم يُبنَ بعد · …», robots noindex. It is still served with status 200 (a soft 404) while no post exists.

claim: Arabic leading floors on the footer poem, .t-lead and wrapping display roles
evidence: site.module.css:214 max(1.55em, 44.8px); globals.css:241-263 .t-title/.t-band-xl/.t-h2-lg 1.25 and --leading-tight 1.25. Exception found: store.module.css .title is 1.2 (policy h1), not wrapped in the defaults tested.

claim: Contact name and message fields take dir=auto, email dir=ltr
evidence: ContactForm.tsx:165, 185, 201.

claim: Lightbox timing on --dur-ui, stable scene keys, 15px label floor, filter as a group with a status
evidence: scenes.module.css:158, 208-211 var(--dur-ui); SceneGallery.tsx:96 key={item.key}; tileTag/category/cardTag use --size-label (15px); role=group plus role=status.

claim: Turnstile renders in Arabic and light
evidence: turnstile.ts:22 TURNSTILE_LOOK {language:'ar', theme:'light'}; with the build's public test key the widget reads «تمّ بنجاح!» on a light card (shots/contact-form-360.png). No size is set (DSN-PAGES-12).

claim: The 404 sets theme-color
evidence: pages.mjs: meta theme-color #e0c6ad on the 404 (global-not-found.tsx:14) and every page.

claim: typeset() glues « · » and closing punctuation to the word before with a no-break space
evidence: format.ts:53: the second replacement inserts bytes C2 A0 (U+00A0) before [.،؛:؟!…»)·].

claim: The error page says what happened
evidence: error.tsx:15-18 «تعذّر عرض هذه الصفحة» / «حاول مرة أخرى…». The root-layout case falls outside it (DSN-PAGES-11).
